paragraphs: Nani, son of Rav Yosef, son of Rava.
In [Yevamot 66b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.66b.9), Nani challenges Rav Kahana: “But did not Rava say in the name of Rav Nachman,” etc.[^2]

notes.text: The supplied Hebrew has the abbreviation ר״ב for the person challenged. See the next note for Hyman’s printed reading and the addressee in Yevamot.

Hyman’s print (vol. III, p. 918) has לר״כ, where the supplied Hebrew has לר״ב. Both the linked Bavli and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2594&lang=en) name Rav Kahana as the addressee. The Bavli gives Nanai, son of Rav Yosef, son of Rava; Hyman’s heading gives Nani.
